# Bhikkhu Saṁyutta (SN 21)

**ID:** SN 21
**Section:** Saṁyuttanikāya (sn)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhu Saṁyutta
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0302m.mul9.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Comparative scholarship has examined the collection alongside its Chinese parallels in the *Saṁyuktāgama* (SĀ, T 99) and the *Bieyi za ahan jing* (SĀ², T 100), establishing that doctrinal differences between the versions are minimal and confined primarily to narrative or scholastic variations [Shulman 2014; Bingenheimer 2011]. Nine suttas have direct parallels in SĀ and seven in SĀ², with occasional parallels in the *Ekottarāgama* (EĀ), including alignments for the *Kolitasutta* (SĀ 501), the *Nandasutta* (EĀ 18.6, SĀ 1067, SĀ² 5), and the *Tissasutta* (SĀ 1068, SĀ² 7) [Bingenheimer 2011].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- This file contains 11 suttas; 11 of them have known parallels. Full parallels by collection: SĀ (9), SA2 (7), Pali (2), EĀ (1)
- Examples of full non-Pali parallels: SN 21.1 Kolitasutta ↔ SA 501 聖默然; SN 21.3 Ghaṭasutta ↔ SA 503 寂滅; SN 21.4 Navasutta ↔ SA2 9 年少; SN 21.4 Navasutta ↔ SA 1070 年少; SN 21.5 Sujātasutta ↔ SA2 1 善生; SN 21.5 Sujātasutta ↔ SA 1062 善生; SN 21.6 Lakuṇḍakabhaddiyasutta ↔ SA2 2 惡色; SN 21.6 Lakuṇḍakabhaddiyasutta ↔ SA 1063 惡色; SN 21.7 Visākhasutta ↔ SA2 8 般闍聞; SN 21.7 Visākhasutta ↔ SA 1069 般闍聞; SN 21.8 Nandasutta ↔ EA 18.6; SN 21.8 Nandasutta ↔ SA2 5 難陀; SN 21.8 Nandasutta ↔ SA 1067 難陀; SN 21.9 Tissasutta ↔ SA2 7 窒師; SN 21.9 Tissasutta ↔ SA 1068 窒師; SN 21.10 Theranāmakasutta ↔ SA2 10 長老; SN 21.10 Theranāmakasutta ↔ SA 1071 長老

**Sources**

- [Bodhi 2003] Bhikkhu Bodhi, The Connected Discourses of the Buddha: A New Translation of the Samyutta Nikāya (2003) — Identified the contents of SN 21, the verse nature of most discourses, and the Chinese Sagāthāvagga placement.
- [Shulman 2014] Eviatar Shulman, Rethinking the Buddha: Early Buddhist Philosophy as Meditative Perception (2014) — Assessed comparative findings by Choong Mun-keat on doctrinal stability between the Pali and Chinese versions.
- [Bingenheimer 2011] Marcus Bingenheimer, Studies in Āgama Literature: With Special Reference to the Shorter Chinese Saṃyuktāgama (2011) — Analyzed parallels in the shorter Chinese Saṁyuktāgama (T 100 / BZA), including specific suttas like the Tissasutta (SN 21.9).
